total_area_sign_flag: total_area was negative in raw data -- physically impossible for an area; flagged, NOT corrected (BR3)
total_area_outlier_flag: total_area > 10x column median -- real scale variation (large estates/land), NOT a decimal typo (BR4); flagged STATISTICAL_OUTLIER, value unchanged
price_per_sqm_outlier_flag: price_per_sqm > 10x median -- mathematically explained by final_sale_price/abs(total_area) (BR6), NOT an independent decimal typo; flagged STATISTICAL_OUTLIER
final_sale_price_outlier_flag: final_sale_price > 10x median -- cross-checked against listing_price (BR5), ratio matches normal population, genuine luxury listing NOT a decimal typo; flagged STATISTICAL_OUTLIER
listing_price_outlier_flag: listing_price > 10x median -- cross-checked against final_sale_price (BR9), ratio matches normal population, genuine luxury listing NOT a decimal typo; flagged STATISTICAL_OUTLIER
land_area_outlier_flag: land_area > 10x median, no divisor landed in plausible band -- flagged STATISTICAL_OUTLIER, not corrected
land_area_decimal_typo_flag: land_area decimal-typo corrected (divided by 10/100/1000 to land within [0.5x,2x] median)
